newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT- M.A. Hanna rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- M.A. Hanna rated buy.

text.p: Salomon Brothers analyst Tim Gerdeman rated M.A. Hanna Co a buy on Friday.
-- He gave the chemical company a 12-month price target of $30, estimates EPS of $1.43 in 1997 and $1.70 in 1998.
-- In a report, he said the stock is trading at a 19 percent discount to the Standard & Poor's 500 Index market multiple, based on a 12-month forward weighted price/earnings multiple of 16.8 times.
-- Gerdeman cited Hanna's strong management and said earnings estimates are understated, due to high goodwill amortization and depreciation expenses.
-- The stock had not been covered by Salomon for about six months.
-- Shares were off 7/8 to 25 on Friday.
